responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_data_structures/src/sync/freeze.rs: Defines `FreezeLock`, a synchronization primitive that owns data which is mutable behind a lock during setup and can be permanently transitioned into an immutable frozen state for lock-free shared access. It provides the read/write guard types and the state transition logic that coordinate safe mutation before freezing and stable shared access after freezing. compiler/rustc_data_structures/src/sync/lock.rs: Implements the module’s dynamic lock abstraction that stores a value and switches between an unsynchronized single-threaded lock mode and a real mutex-backed synchronized mode based on the runtime thread-safety setting. It owns lock acquisition, release, guard behavior, and the `DynSend`/`DynSync`-based API used by the rest of `sync`. compiler/rustc_data_structures/src/sync/parallel.rs: Provides the `sync` module’s runtime-dispatched parallel execution helpers, exposing `join`, scoped spawning, parallel iteration/mapping utilities, and the `parallel!` macro with serial fallbacks when dynamic thread safety is disabled. It also centralizes panic capture and deferred unwinding through `ParallelGuard` so parallel and serial execution report fatal errors consistently. compiler/rustc_data_structures/src/sync/vec.rs: Defines append-only vector containers for shared compiler state, including an index-typed lock-free frozen vector and an `RwLock`-backed append-only vector. This file owns the push-only storage and read/iteration interfaces used when elements may be added concurrently or incrementally but never removed or mutated in place. compiler/rustc_data_structures/src/sync/worker_local.rs: Implements registry-backed worker-local storage for the compiler’s worker threads. It owns thread registration, stable per-thread indexing within a registry, and `WorkerLocal` allocation/access so code can keep one unsynchronized value per registered worker and retrieve only the current worker’s slot.
